request.prompt:
Original editorial product illustration for AdmitFlow, an admissions recovery workspace for coaching institutes. Precision-crafted miniature architectural objects, matte porcelain and fine brushed aluminium with a single restrained cobalt blue #4560E6 accent. Cool neutral off-white #F6F7FA seamless background, directional soft studio lighting from upper left, tactile microtexture, delicate contact shadows. Refined technical, calm, credible, not playful. Asymmetric composition, strong silhouette readable at small sizes, generous negative space and clean edges. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, human faces, screens, dashboards, fake browser chrome, robots, brains, sparkling stars, floating spheres, gradients or purple neon. This is conceptual illustration, not a screenshot or a photograph of a real institute.

A sculptural admissions journey: three low white ceramic platforms arranged diagonally from lower left to upper right, each holding a single upright blank rounded rectangular enquiry tile. A finely machined cobalt channel reconnects a fourth previously separated tile into the middle platform and continues toward a subtle doorway-like open frame at the destination. The blue connecting path is the focal point. Physically coherent crafted tabletop installation, not an infographic. Entire object grouping occupies the right two thirds; left third remains empty. Three-quarter overhead view, editorial still-life photography treatment. Avoid generic 3D icons and excessive objects.

assets.alt: A cobalt path reconnects a separated enquiry tile to a sequence of admissions milestones.
assets.placement: Marketing workflow feature, beside the interactive product preview
assets.processing: Auto-orient; resize without enlargement; saturation 0.96; WebP quality 84; original PNG retained.

request.prompt:
An original, visually arresting editorial illustration for AdmitFlow, an admissions workspace. Art direction: joyful surreal miniature worlds, ambitious art-school poster meets premium animated-film set design. Bold saturated coral orange, ultramarine, lavender violet, buttery sunshine yellow, turquoise and deep forest green, thoughtfully colour-blocked rather than randomly scattered. Inventive sculptural objects with soft clay, ribbed paper, translucent coloured acrylic and glossy enamel finishes. Warm cinematic sunlight, beautiful ambient shadows, rich tactile detail, confident dynamic composition, strong focal point and a beautifully composed full-bleed background. Expressive curves, arches and botanical silhouettes, delightful unexpected scale. Make it colourful, memorable, optimistic and sophisticated, never a bland white product render. No text, letters, numbers, watermarks, brands, fake interface screens, charts, portraits, stock graduation caps or generic robot mascot. Illustration only, not a real institute photograph. Keep every main object inside the frame with enough breathing room for responsive cropping.

THE KNOWLEDGE OBSERVATORY. A fantastical open-sided violet cylindrical reading room with tall sculptural turquoise shelves and oversized coral and butter-yellow blank books arranged into a beautiful spiral staircase. At its centre a large yellow translucent speech bubble is held inside a tilted ultramarine orbital ring like an armillary sphere, a metaphor for finding the right answer. Tiny emerald leaves emerge from the lower shelves. Peach-pink floor, deep periwinkle background, luminous amber highlights, a precise miniature diorama photographed close up. The scene fills the square with bold curved shapes, visual rhythm and friendly intellectual energy. Nothing printed on the books. Not generic stacked books on a white desk.

assets.alt: An imaginative violet observatory holds a sun-yellow conversation shape above a spiral of coral books and turquoise shelves.
assets.placement: Colourful knowledge feature and workspace assistant card
assets.processing: Auto-orient; resize without enlargement; saturation 0.96; WebP quality 84; original PNG retained.

THE OPPORTUNITY GARDEN. A dreamlike architectural garden growing from a deep lavender plinth, against a warm apricot peach background. Dramatically oversized turquoise and emerald folded-paper leaves flank the path, a tiny cobalt staircase climbs to the arch, a pair of small abstract envelope sculptures sits near the starting point. Rich vibrant complementary colours, surprising sculpture, not a flowchart, no empty white background. The garden should feel like a world one could step into.
